title: Supertake raises $20M to let AI agents turn your market predictions into stock portfolios | TechCrunch
summary: To address people’s concerns over AI managing their money, Supertake’s team says it’s implementing certain guardrails and spend limits. Mignano, meanwhile, says he has Supertake managing “hundreds of thousands” of dollars.
